'''"Colonel" Guswan Askreeth''' was a [[cyborg]] with many body parts replaced with repurposed components, including an [[FX-8]] trunk and a [[2-1B surgical droid]] [[Limb|arm]]. In around the [[Standard year|year]] [[34 ABY]], Askreeth spent time on the [[planet]] [[Cantonica]] and watched a [[fathier]] race on the [[Canto Casino and Racetrack|Canto Bight racetrack]] while there.

==Biography==
Shortly after the outbreak of the [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] between the [[First Order]] and the [[Resistance]] in around the [[Standard year|year]] [[34 ABY]], the [[cyborg]] "Colonel" Gusawn Askreeth<ref name="TLJVD" /> spent time on the [[planet]] [[Cantonica]] in the [[city]] of [[Canto Bight]]. The cyborg watched a [[fathier]] race at the [[Canto Casino and Racetrack|Canto Bight racetrack]] and cheered while seated in the racetrack's stands.<ref name="TLJ">{{Film|VIII}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
A repurposed [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[stormtrooper]] [[breath mask]] covered the lower part of Askreeth's face and the "[[colonel]]'s" [[Limb|legs]] and waist were replaced by a customized [[FX-8]] trunk with hidden casters. Askreeth's left arm was replaced with a refurbished [[2-1B surgical droid]] limb, while the right was still organic, but arthritic. What skin the cyborg had left was orange in color and the "colonel's" [[eye]]s were black.<ref name="TLJVD" />

==Equipment==
Askreeth wore a black and white [[Clothing|robe]], black [[glove]]s, and a black waist band over gray [[Cybernetics|cybernetic]] components.<ref name="TLJVD" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Guswan_Askreeth_concept.png|thumb|right|Concept art of Askreeth was titled "Pearl General 05".|150px]]
Guswan Askreeth first appeared in the [[2017]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']]. The character was not named in the film,<ref name="TLJ" /> but received identification in ''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: The Visual Dictionary]]'', a reference book written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and released in conjunction with the film.<ref name="TLJVD" /> Creature concept designer [[Tim Napper]] produced concept art of Askreeth titled "Pearl General 05" which depicted the cyborg with more white clothing and [[hair]] as well as a [[rank insignia plaque]].<ref name="Art">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Last Jedi]]''</ref>
